ads.headline: Lead generation interest drops; service businesses must focus on intent signals now
actions: Audit your $25/day campaigns for high-intent keywords like 'emergency plumber near me' instead of broad service terms
Test lead magnet ads (free estimates, quick quotes) with strict geo-targeting to capture ready-to-buy prospects
Review past week's conversion data and reallocate budget to campaigns with lowest cost-per-qualified-lead, not just impressions
ads.source: Google Trends lead generation interest declining (8/100); Reddit r/FacebookAds weekly discussions on CPL optimization

creative.headline: Unable to provide strategic recommendation — insufficient performance data
actions: Google Trends shows zero volume across all tracked metrics (instagram reels views, content hook, facebook ads creative)
Instagram Insights data missing: no top posts, engagement rates, audience demographics, or week-over-week comparisons available
Cannot identify what's 'failing' without baseline metrics on impressions, saves, shares, or DM conversion rates
creative.source: Incomplete dataset — need @marcomarkets' actual Instagram analytics (top 5-10 posts this week with views/engagement), audience sentiment from comments, and what 'ADS' DM volume looked like by content type

critic.headline: Most failing ads this week have no clear offer — just a service name
actions: Open your current ad — does it have a specific outcome and deadline, or just your service name?
If your CTA is 'Learn More' or 'Contact Us' — change it to 'Get a Free Quote' or similar action
Check your click-to-lead rate: if under 15%, your offer is the problem, not the audience
